# Spiritual Translation

** ¶2:**

The integ rating faculty within the regener ating mind g athers what has been scattered. It subd ues the external natural will — with all its evil desires arising from sens ory and world ly life — and brings the prop rium into conform ity with divine order. This is the sust aining axis of divine truth in its rad iance : the living connection through which interior wisdom descends into the exterior mind and holds it up right, elev ating all that is below toward what is above.

**¶3 :** The one so named is the Divine Human — the Lord as to His celestial nature — who dwells within doctrine formed from divine tru ths that live and flow . He is surrounded by wisdom proce eding from love , and He is called by a name sign ifying that glory : for all divine rad iance of truth in its full ness dw ells in Him , and from Him it is commun icated.

**¶4:** Throughout the whole Grand Human — that is, through every state and degree of the spiritual world — these tru ths are extended . In the in most celest ial heaven they are received in full ness. Across all lesser degrees they are dispers ed and made present , established firmly in the forms that receive them; and the interior lives of all who are in any good of love receive according to their capacity .

---

* A note on the fragments :* The lac unae are extensive . What surv ives is skel etal — yet the correspond ential structure is remark ably coherent: a desc ending axis of truth (* Pillar of Glory*), a celest ial origin dwelling within living doctrine (*First Man* in the * ship of living waters*), and a universal distribution into recept ive inter iors (*souls*). The architecture is that of infl ux : the Lord flows through divine truth into doctrine , through doctrine into every degree of created mind .
